picks.title: 寒夜怪谈
picks.summary: 改编自查尔斯·狄更斯小说《圣诞颂歌》。一位年迈的吝啬商人遭遇故友亡灵及圣诞过去、现在与未来的幽灵造访，被迫直面自己的过往，并踏上一段寻求幸福与救赎的超自然旅程。
picks.summaryEn: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past

picks.title: 如何干一票大的
picks.summary: 别人抢劫东躲西藏，他们直播全网教学，别人抢劫只想暴富，他们只为分给需要的人！当规则不再公平，欲望横流的金钱游戏，谁才是真的掠夺者？
picks.summaryEn: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer.

picks.title: 训练日

picks.summaryEn: On his first day on the job as a narcotics officer, a rookie cop works with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears.

picks.title: 戴高乐之战：淬炼时代
picks.summary: 传记片《戴高乐之战》两部曲第一部。1940年6月，法国战败并签署停战协定。戴高乐将军拒绝投降，独自前往伦敦，试图说服世界继续抵抗。面对重重困境，英国、法国和非洲各地逐渐集结起反抗力量，为自由而战。
picks.summaryEn: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedo

picks.title: 复仇者联盟5：毁灭之日
picks.summary: 来自三个截然不同宇宙的传奇英雄们，将被推向一场生死对决，并最终直面一股前所未见、足以撼动万物存亡的终极威胁。
picks.summaryEn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

picks.title: 饥饿游戏：收获日出
picks.titleEn: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
picks.summary: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。
picks.summaryEn: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
